description.value:
Not every artillery specialist works alone; some prefer to bring their own gun crew. This variant of the Artillerist Technique channels a scout's engineering talent into building and bonding with a dedicated turret companion, letting them coordinate devastating firepower rather than deliver it single-handedly.

Where the solitary Artillerist relies on delayed detonations, this scout invests in a mechanical partner that fights, shields, and strikes alongside them, growing more capable and more dangerous the longer the bond endures. Together, scout and turret turn any battlefield into a kill zone.
